content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are well. Thank you for sending over the agreement. Before I sign, I have one quick request: - Regarding the clause "Except for article 3.1 hereabove, payments shall be made by wire transfer to the bank nominated by Licensor, in maximum 45 days after the issuance by NLS of the corresponding invoices,", payment is due within up to 45 days after invoice issuance, which delays cash flow beyond the standard 30-day term. I propose changing this to: "Except for article 3.1 hereabove, payments shall be made by wire transfer to the bank nominated by Licensor, within thirty (30) days after the issuance by NLS of the corresponding invoices,". Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
